notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.unsupported: Notifications are not available in this browser. On a mobile device, open the app from its Home Screen icon (iOS 16.4+).
notifications.enabled: On for this phone: alerts when the agent finishes, asks for approval, fails or sends a file.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in the device settings for this app.
notifications.browserFailed: Could not turn on notifications in this browser. Try again.
notifications.noSubscription: The browser did not return the subscription. Try again.
notifications.machineRejected: {{name}}: did not accept the subscription. Try turning it on again.
notifications.machineOtherKey: {{name}}: uses a different notification key, so it does not send alerts to this phone. Copy vapid.json from the main PC (see the README) and turn it on again.
notifications.machineUnreachable: {{name}}: did not respond just now. Turn it on again when it is online.
